title: Attention Is All You Need
tldr: Replaces recurrence and convolution entirely with (multi-head) self-attention, yielding a sequence-transduction architecture — the Transformer — that is more parallelizable, trains in a fraction of the time, and sets new single-model state of the art on WMT 2014 translation (28.4 BLEU EN–DE, 41.8 BLEU EN–FR).

tldr: Single-hidden-layer feedforward networks with an arbitrary squashing activation can approximate any continuous function uniformly on compacta and any Borel measurable function in probability — so failures in practice must come from learning, too few hidden units, or noise, never from the architecture class itself.
